{{Quote|You'd think with the pick of any of the worlds in the Unknown Regions that they'd have chosen one a bit more agreeable than this.|[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]|<ref name="refugee" />}}
'''Csilla''', the homeworld of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], was a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of glaciers and snowy wastes located deep within [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]], and served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Chiss Ascendancy.

==Description==
[[File:ChissTEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Chiss scouts on Csilla]]
Csilla was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Csilla system/Legends|Csilla system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> occupying the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Csilla (star)|Csilla]] and located at the junction of the [[Path of the Houses]] and the [[Vagaari Corridor]].<ref name="TEA" /> With standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], a frigid climate,<ref name="LECG" /> and a diameter of 11,080 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], Csilla was orbited by three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and had terrain featuring glaciers and caves.<ref name="TEA" /> Due to the mineral content of the hydrosphere, glaciers on Csilla were a striking blue in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="UoS" /> A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Csilla lasted 25 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard]] [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 462 local days.<ref name="LECG" /> [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] relied on a series of navigational anchor points that spread out from Csilla.<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Csilla was the capital of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]<ref name="TEA" /> and imported resources including foodstuffs, luxury goods,<ref name="LECG" /> and technology<ref name="TEA" /> from other Chiss colonies.<ref name="UoS" /> A network of underground tube transports connected its largest [[City/Legends|city]], [[Csaplar/Legends|Csaplar]], to every other area on the planet,<ref name="TEA" /> including other cities buried in the ice. Cities on Csilla were kept livable by heat from the interior of the planet.<ref name="LECG" /> Csilla was also the center of Chiss politics; their [[Cabinet (Chiss)|Cabinet]] and [[Chiss Senate|Parliament]] could be found at the [[House Palace]] in Csaplar. The [[Csapla family]] was responsible for the distribution of resources to the populace of Csilla.<ref name="UoS" />

==History==
Between [[27,500 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]],<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] reached Csilla in [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] and colonized the planet.<ref name="TEA" /> Genetic analysis indicated that these Humans developed into the Chiss,<ref name="TUR" /> who quickly developed a global government. The need to manage Csilla's population and obtain resources without damaging their homeworld's ecosystem motivated the Chiss space program, which may have benefited from memories of the original colonization effort.<ref name="UoS" />

The planet entered a [[great ice age]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="TUR" />

During the [[Great Galactic War]], negotiators from the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]&mdash;the Chiss' government&mdash;and diplomats of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] met in a summit, which resulted in the Ascendancy offering resources, tax revenues, and armies to the Empire in return for its sovereignty; as part of the decision, no Imperials would enter Csilla without permission.<ref name="HolonetOld-chiss">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|chiss|Chiss}}</ref>

It was also home to the [[Expeditionary Library]].<ref name="refugee" /> [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was born here.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Csilla was inhabited by eight billion [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Chiss,<ref name="UoS" /> who comprised 99% of the population.<ref name="TEA" /> The Chiss were [[near-Human]]s whose blue skin color was partly caused by the mineral content of Csilla's hydrosphere.<ref name="UoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Csilla /ˈt͡ʃilːɒ/ is a Hungarian female given name from ''csillag'' (meaning "star").

Csilla was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
